wv_h_hellbound_area.blurb: Hellbound Area is a section of the Endless Wall cliffline in the New River Gorge, close to Diamond Point and the Honeymooner's Area. It holds eleven routes split fairly evenly between gear lines and bolted sport climbs, running from 5.9 up to the low 5.13s, with most of the weight in the 5.10 to 5.12 range. The rock is sandstone. The wall picks up sun in the morning and can feel chilly once that light moves off in the afternoon. Reaching it means a short walk of around five minutes along the base from the Honeymooner's ladders, which makes it a handy stop for a half day of mid-grade to hard climbing.

wv_0_the_bubba_nest.blurb: The Bubba Nest is a small trad crag within Bubba City on the north side of the New River Gorge. It has ten routes, all gear-protected, from easy low-fifth-class lines through the mid grades up to a couple in the 5.11 range, so it is a good pick for newer leaders and moderate climbers. The rock is sandstone. It feels remote compared with the busy sport sectors nearby, and you may well have it to yourself. The walk follows the cliffline beyond Rubble Rock and crosses a large gully, where a trekking pole helps. Anchors are limited, with trees at the top for rappelling.
